rationale.conceptual: The task requires fitting a predefined scalar equation with four parameters using standard least-squares. No custom algorithm, no deep domain reasoning; it is a textbook operation.
rationale.execution: The workflow consists of loading a single public supplementary table and performing one fit, producing a single JSON output. It is a single script with trivial I/O and no external tooling beyond standard libraries.

difficulty.reasoning: The reproduction task is solely a least-squares fit of a given angular dependence formula to published supplementary data. No custom methods, no heavy computation, no complex pipeline. Both conceptual and execution are at the textbook level.

compute_estimate.reasoning: Only a tiny table of grain orientations and conductivities is processed; fitting a few parameters with scipy requires negligible CPU and memory.
